title: ITERON · MODEL–TASK CHECKPOINT SURFACE
purpose: Explain the research target: select a governed harness checkpoint for each characterized model-task operating region using explicit objectives, constraints and sensitivity evidence.
caption: PORTABILITY IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED.

style.medium: formal systems-paper concept diagram, precise flat boxes, thin marker-like single-headed arrows, generous whitespace, concise monospace labels
style.palette: navy text; cobalt profiles; purple selection; green evidence and registry; amber constraints

nodes.label: MODEL PROFILE
nodes.kind: measured frozen-route capabilities and failure modes

nodes.label: OBJECTIVE + HARD CONSTRAINTS
nodes.kind: service objective, authority, integrity and resource ceilings

nodes.label: CHECKPOINT APPLICABILITY REGISTRY
nodes.kind: supported regions, evidence strength, fallback, expiry and invalidation

nodes.label: CONSTRAINED SELECTOR
nodes.kind: selects from Pareto-admissible checkpoints without granting authority

nodes.label: HARNESS CHECKPOINT
nodes.kind: typed versioned policy bundle with lineage and rollback

nodes.label: BOUNDED RUNTIME TRIAL
nodes.kind: frozen model plus selected harness on the characterized task distribution

nodes.label: OUTCOME VECTOR
nodes.kind: quality, cost, latency and reliability with uncertainty

nodes.label: SENSITIVITY EVIDENCE
nodes.kind: paired harness perturbation deltas conditioned on model and task

forbidden_edges.reason: Selection must resolve a versioned checkpoint rather than inject an anonymous configuration.
Model identity alone cannot determine a checkpoint without a task profile and objective.
Task identity alone cannot determine a checkpoint without a model profile and objective.
Raw outcomes require governed sensitivity and applicability evidence before selection.
Evidence cannot activate a checkpoint directly.

layout_notes: Use three clean vertical zones from left to right: operating cell, selection, evidence.
Stack model profile, task profile, and objective plus hard constraints vertically, feeding the model by task cell in three separate lanes.
Place checkpoint applicability registry directly below constrained selector so CS-05 is short and vertical; place harness checkpoint to the right of selector.
Place runtime trial, outcome vector, and sensitivity evidence left to right in the evidence zone.
Route CS-10 as one dashed lower lane from sensitivity evidence leftward into checkpoint applicability registry. Its arrowhead touches only the registry.
Do not draw a Cartesian grid of individual benchmark questions. Task profile means a characterized class or distribution.
Do not show model weights changing. The model route is frozen.
